research_question: Does experimentally altered maternal host choice translate into a change in survival-weighted offspring production under two available diets, with documented independent cohorts and biological limits?
original_source: Jones & Agrawal 2019 Oikos doi:10.1111/oik.06001; Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.8hd6764

published_prior_art.learning: 24-hour prior experience manipulated experimentally; learned preference reversal ALREADY PUBLISHED
published_prior_art.quality: A. incarnata subsp. pulchra had lower larval pupation success ~22% than A. incarnata subsp. incarnata ~43%; published Fisher p≈0.17 for four diets; difference not firmly established
published_prior_art.botanical_origin: Both target Asclepias incarnata subspecies are native; this is a mechanistic control, NOT a native vs introduced host comparison.
published_prior_art.population: No host-removal, multi-generation host-dependence or post-loss adult recruitment outcome in this experiment
published_prior_art.related_prior_art: Gowri & Monteiro 2024 DOI 10.1111/nyas.15090 tested odor preference across five generations and removal; acquired preference disappeared after stimulus withdrawal. Odor manipulation is NOT actual host replacement.

require_choice_file: post-treatment choice egg counts on each of two plant taxa
require_performance_file: survived to pupation (or tracked status for all assigned)
analysis_gate.sample_units: female (choice) and larva nested by clutch (performance), separate non-paired cohorts
analysis_gate.estimand: Expected pupae per 100 eggs assigned to a host by each experience arm, holding observed diet-specific pupation probabilities fixed; Δ=(p_exp-p_control)×(q_alternative-q_preferred)
analysis_gate.bootstrap: Resample female IDs for preference and independently larval clutches for quality; if clutch unavailable, do not claim narrow intervals using larvae as independent units
analysis_gate.positive: Interval for the conditional cross-stage proxy excludes zero and positive direction; descriptive source-conditional proxy, not observed viable adult or demographic rescue
analysis_gate.negative: CI spans zero or sign opposite; no robust increase in proxy
stop: No randomized exposure ID or group assignment -> no causal choice estimate
Pupation lacks full denominator -> no performance proxy
Different plant taxa / rearing contexts between experiments -> no cross-stage linkage
No same larvae as laid eggs -> cross-stage proxy only
No introduced-host exposure or removal -> no statement about plant globalization/hysteresis

independent_publication_requirement: Cross-species/individual-tracking experimental history×host-loss adult recruitment after matched current food supplies; numerical proxy alone cannot establish ecological generality.
